== English Decipher comparison ==
The printed Jabba's Palace face allows the draw during your turn if with imprisoned captives. Decipher's [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=1 Glossary Supplement] (29 January 2002) limits the draw to once during each of your turns and uses the singular “captive.” Cancellation targets, destiny threshold and random release match. The Supplement and later [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=102 2023 Advanced Rulebook] spell the same canceled Interrupt with different numbers of g's. The table preserves the published wording and highlights the captive clause.
